dct_description_sm:
Point layer of bus access stops of the Shawinigan Public Transport Board (RTCS) on the territory of the city of Shawinigan.

[Link to the complete Isogeo sheet] (https://open.isogeo.com/s/b6da64af30234cbda2afed3972a5fc3e/Urd8YxfJdWSzGaUmhHFMY60vx14s0/r/f72cba67662b4b289105b52c5b7d412c?lock)

! [Shawinigan logo] (https://jmap.shawinigan.ca/doc/photos/LogoShawinigan.jpg)

! [RTCS logo] (https://jmap.shawinigan.ca/doc/photos/RTCS-Copie.jpg)


**Collection method**

Location at the corresponding address

**Attributes**

* `objectid` (`integer`): 

* `zones` (`char`): Area

* `address` (`char`): Address

* `coin_rue` (`char`): Street corner

* `abri_bus` (`char`): Bus shelter

* `embarkation` (`char`): Boarding number

**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**

Couche ponctuelle des arrêts accès bus de la régie de transport en commun de Shawinigan (RTCS) sur le territoire de la ville de Shawinigan.
